about:
# Gamemode Swapper

Allows you to edit multiple aspects of your player. Such as:
- Gamemode
- Speed
- Platformer
- Size
- Gravity

Aswell as disable portals from working.

## Credits
- [Dasshu](user:1975253) for the logo
- [availax](user:1621348) for the mod textures

# Changelog
## v1.0.10
- Support for 2.2081
## v1.0.9
- Internal changes in preperation for 2.208

## v1.0.8
- Added mac support
## v1.0.7
- Added reverse player button

- Updated for 2.2074

- Bottom button now is added to a menu, preventing overlapping with the coins in menu mod
- Removed some leftover logs
- Added Node IDS as a depencency
- Added "gameplay" tag
## v1.0.2
- Fixed the platformer UI not appearing on Android
